caption:
closing rings is attendance. it isn't a plan.

#applewatch #fitnessmotivation #routine

slides.text:
Closing rings is not
a training plan

A ring closes the same way
for a hard session
and a long supermarket trip

It measures attendance

It does not know
what you were doing there

A plan names the session

Blocks, reps, and how hard
each one should feel

And it closes
for a reason

slides.heading: Attendance, or a programme
slides.body: SOMA turns the same wrist data into a named session for today, not three circles to fill
